description: Allowlist for known vulnerabilities with documented mitigations. Entries must include expiration dates and will be automatically flagged when expired.

entries.reason: SheetJS xlsx prototype pollution vulnerability (GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6). Mitigation: File upload validation implemented in client/components/shared/SpreadsheetImporter.tsx with size limits and type checking. No user-supplied file paths processed. Awaiting upstream fix. Reviewed 2026-08-31: SpreadsheetImporter mitigations (size limits, type checking) verified in place; no user-supplied file paths processed.

SheetJS xlsx ReDoS vulnerability (GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9). Mitigation: File size limits enforced, no untrusted patch/diff processing. Awaiting upstream fix. Reviewed 2026-08-31: SpreadsheetImporter mitigations (size limits, type checking) verified in place; no user-supplied file paths processed.

notes: This allowlist should be reviewed monthly during security reviews.
2026-08-31 review: both xlsx entries re-verified (mitigations confirmed, upstream unfixed); extended to 2026-11-30.
Expired entries will cause the CI security gate to fail.
All entries must have documented mitigations and expiration dates.
